blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque on Tuesday disputed Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla’s claim that his asylum application had been denied, saying he was still awaiting a decision from authorities. “Fake news. Sunog na naman sya. No such rule exists. My application for asylum has been submitted for resolution and I continue to await the decision of Austrian asylum authorities,” Roque said in a text message to INQUIRER. “Until the Austrian authorities themselves issue a decision on my application, claims that my asylum bid has already been denied are false and misleading,” he added in a separate statement. “There […]...
